summary: Atrium Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing FDA clearance of its IND application for ATR 1072, a RNA therapeutic for PRKAG2 syndrome, allowing initiation of the Corventis Phase 1/2 clinical trial. This is a routine regulatory update about a drug development milestone, not a special situation corporate event. The filing contains no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other structural change. No deal terms are stated.
